about_the_game:
THE BASEMENT REMEMBERS
When you took the job as a receptionist in this sleepy town, the rented house seemed perfect. But the previous tenants—a loving couple—left behind more than just furniture. Their secrets are buried in the basement, and she wants you to uncover them.

A Psychological Horror Experience

  • Atmospheric Exploration: Navigate the decaying house, where every creak and shadow hides clues.

  • Deep Storytelling: Piece together the tragic tale of the wife through diary entries, ghostly visions, and environmental storytelling.

  • Puzzles with Purpose: Solve riddles tied to the narrative—unlock the basement, decipher cryptic notes, and confront the truth.

  • Haunting Encounters: Experience chilling events that escalate as you delve deeper. No cheap jump scares—just relentless dread.

"I just wanted to be loved..."
The wife’s spirit lingers, not as a monster, but as a desperate soul reliving her final days. Will you help her find peace, or become another victim of the basement’s curse?

Features:
🔦 *3-5 hours* of immersive, story-driven horror.
📖 Multiple endings based on your choices.
🕯️ No combat—only your wits and courage.

"Basement is a love letter to classic psychological horror—slow-burn, emotional, and deeply unsettling."

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: 4 core CPU
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM; Radeon RX 470, GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: 6 or 8 core CPU
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 MB available space

short_description: You’ve just moved into your new home. The neighbors are quiet. But the basement... isn’t empty. Uncover the tragic truth behind the house’s previous owners in this story-driven psychological horror experience. Explore, and survive the lingering presence of a soul trapped in darkness.
